{{Top|leg}}
'''Gadrin Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Nadin Paal]] maintained a warehouse in [[Docking Bay 77]] of the spaceport. Following the return of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kills]] traveled to the spaceport and attempted to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Paal.
